auth.sql: INSERT INTO profile_auth_recovery_quarantine_canonical ( profile_id, revision_token, reason, quarantined_at_ms ) SELECT job.profile_id, CAST(job.revision AS TEXT), ?, ? FROM profile_auth_recovery_jobs_canonical AS job WHERE job.profile_id = CASE WHEN ? = 'blob' THEN ? ELSE CAST(? AS TEXT) END AND typeof(job.profile_id) = ? AND CAST(job.profile_id AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(job.login_uids_json) = ? AND CAST(job.login_uids_json AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(job.source_profile_ids_json) = ? AND CAST(job.source_profile_ids_json AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(job.source_phase) = ? AND CAST(job.source_phase AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(job.prize_cursor) = ? AND CAST(job.prize_cursor AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(job.phase_started_at_ms) = ? AND CAST(job.phase_started_at_ms AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(job.last_enqueued_at_ms) = ? AND CAST(job.last_enqueued_at_ms AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(job.created_at_ms) = ? AND CAST(job.created_at_ms AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(job.updated_at_ms) = ? AND CAST(job.updated_at_ms AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(job.revision) = ? AND job.revision IS ? AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM profile_canonical_control WHERE singleton = 1 AND state = 'active' ) ON CONFLICT(profile_id) DO UPDATE SET revision_token = excluded.revision_token, reason = excluded.reason, quarantined_at_ms = excluded.quarantined_at_ms WHERE profile_auth_recovery_quarantine_canonical.revision_token != excluded.revision_token

event-progress.sql: WITH observed AS MATERIALIZED ( SELECT rating.operation_id, rating.revision, rating.event_progress_state AS recovery_state, rating.event_progress_updated_at_ms AS recovery_updated_at_ms, rating.invite_id, rating.match_id, rating.event_progress_version AS version, (SELECT CASE WHEN type = 'text' THEN CAST(atom AS BLOB) ELSE NULL END FROM json_each(rating.payload_json) WHERE key = 'eventId' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1) AS event_id_bytes FROM rating_updates_canonical AS rating WHERE rating.operation_id = CASE WHEN ? = 'blob' THEN ? ELSE CAST(? AS TEXT) END AND rating.event_progress_state = 'pending' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM profile_canonical_control WHERE singleton = 1 AND state = 'active' ) ) INSERT INTO rating_projection_recovery_quarantine_canonical ( operation_id, projection_kind, revision_token, reason, quarantined_at_ms ) SELECT observed.operation_id, ?, CAST(observed.revision AS TEXT), ?, ? FROM observed WHERE typeof(observed.operation_id) = ? AND CAST(observed.operation_id AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(observed.revision) = ? AND observed.revision IS ? AND typeof(observed.invite_id) = ? AND CAST(observed.invite_id AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(observed.match_id) = ? AND CAST(observed.match_id AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(observed.version) = ? AND CAST(observed.version AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(observed.event_id_bytes) = ? AND CAST(observed.event_id_bytes AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(observed.recovery_state) = ? AND CAST(observed.recovery_state AS BLOB) IS ? AND typeof(observed.recovery_updated_at_ms) = ? AND CAST(observed.recovery_updated_at_ms AS BLOB) IS ? ON CONFLICT (operation_id, projection_kind) DO UPDATE SET revision_token = excluded.revision_token, reason = excluded.reason, quarantined_at_ms = excluded.quarantined_at_ms WHERE rating_projection_recovery_quarantine_canonical.revision_token != excluded.revision_token
